# MinHook

The hooking library of Lootnest's in-game FPS counter (`native/overlay`),
from https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook at commit
8af6b4acae5a9388fd742b56fa79ece89d96f823, unchanged: `include/`, `src/`,
`LICENSE.txt` (BSD 2-clause) and `AUTHORS.txt`. Only `src/hde/hde64.c` is
built (64-bit).
